Usage: gotools completion <bash|zsh|fish|pwsh|install>

  Print the completion script of a shell, or install it where the shell loads it
  from. The scripts ask gotools for the commands, flags and tool names as you
  type, so they never go stale.

    source <(gotools completion bash)    # bash: put it in ~/.bashrc
    source <(gotools completion zsh)     # zsh: put it in ~/.zshrc
    gotools completion fish | source     # fish
    gotools completion install           # write it where the shell loads it from

  Examples:
    gotools completion bash
    gotools completion install
    gotools completion install zsh
